subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the 14 grouped action revisions be accepted together for OpenClaw's credentialed security, agent, release, and repository-automation workflows after exact-head validation?
rationale: The patch is mechanically consistent, but several updated actions execute with secrets or publishing authority and their full operational coverage depends on maintainer-owned workflows that PR CI cannot completely exercise.

options.title: Approve the grouped pins
options.body: Accept the immutable upstream revisions together after required checks finish on the final rebased SHA and an owner reviews the sensitive workflow changelogs.

options.title: Split sensitive updates
options.body: Separate Codex, GitHub App token, CodeQL, and Docker release actions from ordinary setup and repository-maintenance actions for narrower validation and rollback.

options.title: Pause the bundle
options.body: Keep the existing pins until a dedicated credentialed workflow validation window is available.

recommendation.title: Approve the grouped pins
recommendation.body: Accept the immutable upstream revisions together after required checks finish on the final rebased SHA and an owner reviews the sensitive workflow changelogs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to release workflow operation and hardening across the most consequential changed path.
